_comment: Committed host paths for an HPC cluster (A100-80GB SXM4, sm80) under Slurm. Values are FILESYSTEM LOCATIONS, never design (D-609). Boot fails closed if flexidepth_weights, conditional_graph_helper or moe_config_dir is absent. Unlike the Vast container, the cluster has a real shared filesystem, so these paths are stable across allocations and every node sees the same bytes. Replace the placeholders with your own locations.
